business_definition: Unique identifier for each branch.
business_rule: Must be unique for every branch.

business_definition: Name of the branch or warehouse location.
business_rule: Branch name should be unique within the organization.

business_definition: City where the branch is located.
State or administrative region where the branch is located.
Business region to which the branch belongs.
Type or classification of warehouse operated by the branch.
business_rule: Examples may include Central, Regional, Local or Distribution.

business_definition: Maximum storage capacity of the warehouse.
business_rule: Should be greater than or equal to zero.

business_definition: Indicates whether the branch has an associated service center.
Identifier of the employee or manager responsible for the branch.
Total number of employees assigned to the branch.
Average monthly revenue generated by the branch.
Average monthly operating cost of the branch.
Index representing demand for products in the branch market.
business_rule: Higher values indicate stronger market demand.

business_definition: Unique identifier for each customer.
Classification of customer.
business_rule: Examples include Retail, Distributor, OEM or Industrial.

business_definition: Industry sector in which the customer operates.
Customer city.
Customer state.
Postal or ZIP code of the customer.
Business region associated with the customer.
Branch responsible for servicing the customer.
Maximum credit amount approved for the customer.
Current outstanding amount owed by the customer.
business_rule: Should normally be zero or greater.

business_definition: Agreed payment terms with the customer.
business_rule: Examples include COD, Net 30 or Net 60.

business_definition: Date on which the customer relationship began.
Date of the customer's most recent purchase.
Cumulative purchase value of the customer.
Business rating assigned to the customer.
business_rule: Rating scale should be defined consistently by the organization.

business_definition: Product maintained in branch inventory.
Branch where the inventory is stored.
Stock quantity available at the beginning of the inventory period.
Stock level at which replenishment should be initiated.
business_rule: Should normally be greater than or equal to safety stock.

business_definition: Minimum buffer inventory maintained to protect against uncertainty.
Maximum desired stock quantity.
business_rule: Should be greater than or equal to reorder level.

business_definition: Current available stock quantity.
Physical bin or storage location within the warehouse.
Unique identifier for an invoice.
Sales order from which the invoice was generated.
Customer billed on the invoice.
Branch responsible for the invoice.
Date on which the invoice was issued.
Date by which invoice payment is due.
business_rule: Should normally be on or after invoice date.

business_definition: Value of goods or services before GST.
Total GST charged on the invoice.
Total invoice amount including GST.
business_rule: Normally equals total order value plus GST.

business_definition: Current payment status of the invoice.
business_rule: Examples: Paid, Partially Paid, Unpaid, Overdue.

business_definition: Unique identifier for a payment transaction.
Invoice against which the payment was received.
Date on which payment was received.
Amount received from the customer.
Method used to make the payment.
business_rule: Examples include Bank Transfer, Cheque, UPI or Cash.

business_definition: Unique identifier for each product.
Name or description of the product.
Product category.
Type of machine or equipment associated with the product.
Manufacturer or brand of the product.
Machine models compatible with the product.
Standard or current cost of one unit.
Standard selling price per unit.
business_rule: Should normally be greater than or equal to unit cost.

business_definition: Profit margin percentage associated with the product.
GST percentage applicable to the product.
business_rule: Should be a valid tax percentage.

business_definition: Weight of one product unit in kilograms.
Physical dimensions of the product in centimeters.
Primary material used to manufacture the product.
Warranty duration in months.
Inventory level at which replenishment should be triggered.
Minimum buffer stock maintained for demand or supply uncertainty.
Maximum desired inventory level.
Expected number of days required to replenish the product.
Business importance or operational criticality of the product.
Frequency with which the product is consumed or sold.
Unit of measure for the product.
Price paid during the most recent purchase.
Date of the most recent purchase.
Unique identifier for a purchase order.
Supplier receiving the purchase order.
Branch placing or receiving the purchase order.
Date on which the purchase order was created.
Expected date of delivery from the supplier.
Actual date on which the purchase order was received.
Current status of the purchase order.
business_rule: Examples: Open, Approved, Partially Received, Received, Cancelled.

business_definition: Purchase order value before GST.
Total GST applicable to the purchase order.
Total purchase order value including GST.
business_rule: Normally equals total cost plus GST.

business_definition: Purchase order associated with the line.
business_rule: Must reference a valid purchase order.

business_definition: Sequential line number within a purchase order.
business_rule: Must be unique within each purchase order.

business_definition: Product being purchased.
Quantity of product ordered.
Purchase cost per product unit.
GST percentage applicable to the line item.
Line value before GST.
business_rule: Normally quantity multiplied by unit cost.

business_definition: GST amount calculated for the line.
Line total including GST.
business_rule: Normally line total plus GST amount.

business_definition: Unique identifier for a sales order.
Customer placing the sales order.
Branch responsible for fulfilling the order.
Date on which the sales order was created.
Expected or actual delivery date.
Current status of the sales order.
business_rule: Examples: Open, Confirmed, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled.

business_definition: Payment conditions applicable to the order.
Sales order value before GST.
Total GST applicable to the sales order.
Total sales order value including GST.
Channel through which the order was received.
Sales order associated with the line.
business_rule: Must reference a valid sales order.

business_definition: Sequential line number within the sales order.
business_rule: Must be unique within each sales order.

business_definition: Product being sold.
Quantity of product ordered.
Selling price per unit.
GST percentage applicable to the sales line.
Sales line value before GST.
business_rule: Normally quantity multiplied by unit price.

business_definition: GST amount for the sales line.
Sales line value including GST.
business_rule: Normally line total plus GST amount.

business_definition: Unique identifier for an inventory movement.
Product affected by the inventory movement.
Branch where the inventory movement occurred.
Type of stock movement.
business_rule: Examples: Receipt, Sale, Return, Adjustment, Transfer.

business_definition: Date and time when the inventory movement occurred.
Quantity involved in the stock movement.
business_rule: Positive or negative interpretation should be defined according to movement type.

business_definition: Type of business document that caused the stock movement.
Identifier of the source business document.
Inventory balance after the movement.
Unique identifier for each supplier.
Legal or trading name of the supplier.
Classification of supplier.
Primary product category supplied by the supplier.
Supplier city.
Province or state where the supplier is located.
Geographical or business region of the supplier.
Postal or ZIP code of the supplier.
Typical number of days required by the supplier to deliver an order.
Score measuring supplier delivery and service reliability.
business_rule: Use a consistent scoring scale such as 0 to 100.

business_definition: Import duty percentage applicable to goods supplied.
Tax identification number for the supplier where applicable.
business_rule: Should be unique for registered suppliers.
